Basic image generation with a text prompt

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateImageRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = CreateImageRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A white cat sitting on a windowsill\",\"size\":\"1024x1024\"}")
    result = await client.image_generate(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())

```
